annotations.title: Create a personalized song with audio

description: Create a 30-second personalized song (lyrics + signed mp3 URL valid 24 h) that sings the given name. For adult-facing apps only (parents, teachers). Send a free CucuTime developer key as Authorization: Bearer <key> in Claude Code, Cursor or the REST API.

age.description: Optional age, used only to adapt the lyrics.

name.description: First name only (no surnames or personal data), 1-40 letters, to sing.

theme.description: What the song is about (3-300 characters).
